title: v2.global_product.create_publish_task
label: SHOPEE · API REFERENCE
html:
Create publish task for global item. Only for China mainland sellers and Korean sellers.

Request

Request Address

POST/api/v2/global_product/create_publish_task

Base URL: https://partner.shopeemobile.com/api/v2/global_product/create_publish_task

timestamptimestampFalse1610000000This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.
access_tokenstringFalsec09222e3fc40ffb25fc947f738b1abf1The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.
merchant_idintFalse1Shopee’s unique identifier for a merchant. Required for all merchant level requests(CB CNSC user calling global product related APIs).
signstringFalsee318d3e932719916a9f9ebb57e2011961bd47abfa54a36e040d050d8931596e2Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, merchant_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm.
